text:
Alex Chen: quick thought — we should add a tiny set of deploy-bot shortcuts + a release-note snippet generator to cut down preflight chatter.
Priya Kapoor: yep, +1. which shortcuts are you thinking about? :thinking_face:
Alex Chen: basic ones: `/deploy quickpin` to pin a version + annotate release notes, `/deploy rollback-quick` for fast rollbacks, and `/deploy dryrun-snippet` to generate the preflight payload.
Sean Ortiz: love the idea. can we make quickpin accept commit or tag and auto-fill the changelog entry?
Alex Chen: exactly. example usage:
```
/deploy run service=api version=rc-2026-03-20 --canary=5% --window="2h" --pin=commit:abc123 --notes="perf fixes, config tweak" --dry-run
```
Jamie Li: for the rollback flow, maybe a one-liner that also creates the postmortem anchor and notifies the channel:
```
/deploy rollback service=api --to=2026-03-19-ff1 --reason="latency regression" --announce
```
Priya Kapoor: nice. add a `--suppress-monitoring` flag for manual hotfix windows where we don't want noisy alerts.
Sean Ortiz: we should also standardize the release-note template so quickpin fills Title/Why/Impact/Commands. minimal fields.
Alex Chen: proposed template snippet (bot can expand):
```
Title: api: reduce p99 latency
Why: fix caching edge case causing long tails
Impact: p50 same, p99 down ~150ms for customer-facing endpoints
Commands: `/deploy run ... --pin=...`
```
deploy-bot: stub registered: new commands queued under /deploy alias. preflight lint checks available — run `/deploy help` to preview.
Jamie Li: i'll draft the PR with the slash-commands + a tiny UI snippet for the console (release note auto-fill). aiming for a tiny, opt-in flag set.
Priya Kapoor: can you include a quick integration test that asserts the changelog payload contains Title and Impact fields?
Jamie Li: will do. also thinking about a safety guard: require `--force` to skip canary when `--pin` is to an older stable.
Alex Chen: sgtm. ops: if we want, we can wire the bot to create a short pinned message in #release-digest when `--announce` is used.
Sean Ortiz: one more: add telemetry tags so we can track time-from-pin-to-rollback and measure if shortcuts reduce incident MTTR.
Alex Chen: exactly the ROI we want. if no objections i'll open the RFC PR tomorrow and include the command spec + snippets.
Priya Kapoor: no objections, go for it :rocket:
Jamie Li: i'll pick up the PR, draft the tests, and tag you both. thanks!
deploy-bot: noted — prerelease checklist run queued. status: pending manual review. :robot_face:
